summary: Phase 2 (Property Acquisition) end-to-end review. Backend pytest: 17/17 PASS covering Territory CRUD + RBAC (sales 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE, 200 on GET), invalid polygon 422, import preview (mode=sample, rentcast_configured=false, estimated_properties>0), import run + strict idempotency (2nd run created=0, updated>0, total property count unchanged), properties list/geojson/detail, DNK toggle by sales, visit with outcome=do_not_knock flips property, convert-to-lead fallback to owner name, /leads listing, change-password (wrong -> 400, correct -> 200 -> revert to original -> re-login OK), and territory-delete preserves properties (territory_id becomes null on kept properties). Frontend: login + RoofSpan wordmark render, sidebar app icon visible, /map renders territory-panel + non-zero map-container (864x900) with OSM tiles, draw-territory workflow (4 clicks -> Finish -> name dialog -> Save) creates a territory that appears in the list, import dialog shows amber SAMPLE-DATA notice + estimated properties = 25, confirm import completes and property_count updates to '25 properties', change-password dialog opens with wrong current password showing 'Current password is incorrect' toast. All primary Phase 2 flows verified via a combination of API tests and UI automation.
critical_code_review_comments: imports.py _run_import commits every 10 processed rows but sets job.status='completed' only at the end. If the process crashes mid-run, the job stays 'running' forever with no watchdog. Consider a background sweeper or persist heartbeat/last-updated timestamp. Non-blocking for Phase 2.

properties.py convert_to_lead uses payload.name.strip() but does not enforce upper cap or validate visit_id ownership (source_visit_id could point to any visit). Low risk in a trusted office app but worth constraining.
MapView.jsx uses window.confirm for destructive delete; consider replacing with shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the UI.

MapView 'prop-points' click handler ignores clicks that fall on the territory fill layer if a pin sits on the outline — MapLibre delegates the top-most feature so it usually works, but the 6px pin radius makes precise pixel clicks brittle for automated tests. Consider increasing circle-radius to 8-10 or adding an invisible larger hit-layer for better accessibility (tap targets ~44px on mobile).
ImportDialog polls at 700ms for up to 120 iterations (~84s). If the sample generator generates 500 records it can exceed that; consider dynamic timeout based on max_records or a websocket/SSE.
auth.py change-password does not invalidate existing JWTs on password change. Non-blocking for phase 2 but a common security-review item.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — every Phase 2 flow verified except the map-pin-click → PropertySheet interaction, which is a Playwright automation limitation (6px circle radius makes headless pixel-hits brittle). All required data-testids are present on PropertySheet/owner-info/dnk-toggle/add-visit/convert-lead/convert-lead-dialog/lead-name/save-lead.
